title: Agent view
description: An Agent's five-phase view (#15397, docs/plans/plan-typed-core.md 2.1, step P5): AgentPhase, AgentReason and AgentView, which the manager computes onto Session.view.

AgentPhase.description: Where an Agent stands, in one of five phases (docs/protocol/agent-states.md "Five phases"): it needs the owner, it works, it finished, it stopped on an error, or it is idle.

AgentReason.description: Why an Agent is in its phase, tagged by kind. Each phase has its own reasons; a kind this app does not know reads as unknown.

ReasonCards.description: needs_you: pending cards (questions, plans, permissions, forms) stand for it, its folded children's included.

n.description: How many cards its row holds.

held.description: None of them is the owner's yet: questions the assistant is still deciding on (D11).

ReasonTerminalDialog.description: needs_you: a dialog its terminal shows that no card stands for.

ReasonTurn.description: working: its turn runs, or its task's supervisor holds every card it asked.

ReasonBackground.description: working: its turn ended and only its background work runs (#2935).

waiting.description: That work only waits: background commands that sleep or watch something, no subagent or workflow (#6045).

ReasonUnseen.description: done: it finished and the owner has not seen the result.

ReasonJustFinished.description: done: seen, and its turn finished before anybody looked at it, within the triage's window (#9751).

ReasonAsks.description: done: it stopped on a question to the owner nobody answered yet (D-A, #5096): not counted in Needs you.

question.description: What it asks, as the node read it off the reply; empty when the triage only says it waits on the owner.

unseen.description: The owner has not seen the reply yet.

ReasonUsageLimit.description: error: a subscription's usage limit ended its turn.

resets_at.description: When the limit resets; absent when not known.

resumes.description: Its CLI goes on by itself once the limit resets.

ReasonModel.description: error: a model API error ended its turn.

code.description: What is wrong when the hub can tell (Session.turn_error_code: not_logged_in, auth_failed, model_route, rate_limited…); empty when it cannot.

ReasonStartRefused.description: error: its start was refused or failed.

code.description: The start's coded refusal (Session.start_error_code: claude_missing, launcher_missing…); empty for a start that failed without one.

ReasonRestartInterrupted.description: error: it was running when its computer's node restarted, and nothing carries it on until the owner says so (#1917, D-C).

ReasonSeen.description: idle: finished and seen, ready for input.

ReasonNotRunning.description: idle: no process runs it (a transcript with no live agent).

ReasonHostUnknown.description: idle: its host does not say where it stands (D-B); a screen may say "status unknown".

AgentView.description: An Agent as every client draws it, computed by the manager (docs/protocol/agent-states.md "Five phases"): its phase and why, whether it counts in the Agents list's Needs you, and where it sorts. Clients draw it and sort by rank; they never derive it.

counted.description: Its row counts in the Agents list's Needs you (the badge, the header, the filter): fleetcount's decision, never recomputed.

rank.description: Where it sorts, lower first: one order for every client (docs/protocol/agent-states.md "Rank"). Equal ranks go by the shared tie-break.
